description: This file contains functions and definitions related to handling Git tags, including verification of signatures, dereferencing tags, looking up tags, parsing tag data, and managing tag objects within a Git repository.

classes.name: struct tag
classes.description: Represents a Git tag object, including its related data such as the tag message, tagger, date, and the object it points to.

classes.name: struct object
classes.description: A generic object representing any Git object (commit, tree, blob, tag), used in various repository functions.

classes.name: struct repository
classes.description: Represents a Git repository with access to its object database and configuration.

methods.name: int run_gpg_verify(const char * buf,unsigned long size,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Verifies a GPG signature for a given buffer, outputting verification status based on flags.

methods.name: int gpg_verify_tag(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid,const char * name_to_report,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Verifies the GPG signature of a tag object within a repository.

methods.name: struct:object * deref_tag(struct repository * r,struct object * o,const char * warn,int warnlen)
methods.description: Recursively dereferences a tag to its underlying object, warning if the object is missing.

methods.name: struct:tag * lookup_tag(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Looks up a tag object in a repository by its object ID, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: timestamp_t parse_tag_date(const char * buf,const char * tail)
methods.description: Parses the date from a tag's metadata.

methods.name: void release_tag_memory(struct tag * t)
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a tag object.

methods.name: int parse_tag_buffer(struct repository * r,struct tag * item,const void * data,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Parses the raw data buffer of a tag to extract its metadata and content.

methods.name: int parse_tag(struct repository * r,struct tag * item)
methods.description: Parses a tag object from the repository into a structured tag object.

methods.name: struct:object_id * get_tagged_oid(struct tag * tag)
methods.description: Retrieves the object ID of the object tagged by a given tag.

ctags.name: deref_tag
ctags.pattern: /^struct object *deref_tag(struct repository *r, struct object *o, const char *warn, int warnlen)$/
ctags.signature: (struct repository * r,struct object * o,const char * warn,int warnlen)

ctags.name: gpg_verify_tag
ctags.signature: (struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid,const char * name_to_report,unsigned flags)

ctags.name: parse_tag_buffer
ctags.pattern: /^int parse_tag_buffer(struct repository *r, struct tag *item, const void *data, unsigned long siz/
ctags.signature: (struct repository * r,struct tag * item,const void * data,unsigned long size)

ctags.name: run_gpg_verify
ctags.pattern: /^static int run_gpg_verify(const char *buf, unsigned long size, unsigned flags)$/
